title: Fabricated proof-shaped content
guidance: Use supplied or independently verified proof only
Mark an unresolved proof slot visibly or change the structure
avoid: Anonymous testimonials written by the designer

title: Argument compressed for layout convenience
guidance: Preserve meaning force qualifications and idiolect
Change measure disclosure or page rhythm instead of weakening content

title: Generic wellness softness
guidance: Derive warmth and calm from the specific method and audience
Let evidence boundaries and author voice carry trust
avoid: Pastel gradients used as a substitute for credibility

title: Genre-blind landing-page rhythm
guidance: Derive section order from the user's mental questions
Vary structure across unrelated products while preserving within-product family
avoid: Hero then three equal cards then CTA by default
Generic navigation labels unrelated to user goals

title: Containment without semantic reason
guidance: Use containment to express a real grouping or state boundary
Prefer type spacing and alignment when a box adds no meaning
avoid: Uniform bordered panels for unrelated content

title: Motion as ambient decoration
guidance: Use motion to clarify state change sequence or spatial relationship
Respect reduced-motion preferences and interrupted interactions
avoid: Bounce or wobble with no semantic role

title: Mixed icon voice
guidance: Choose one coherent icon family or custom system
Treat icon weight and geometry as typography
avoid: Emoji mixed with multiple icon libraries
Icons used where a text label is clearer

title: Catalog-first styling
guidance: Establish product truth and L0 through L4 requirements before pattern search
Use catalog results to compare options or fill implementation detail
avoid: Selecting a visual style from industry category alone
Replacing incumbent identity with the top search result
